must_findings.title: The Python test corpus's centre of mass is code with zero production callers, so a green Python gate cannot evidence closure
evidence: Eleven public factories have no non-test caller in codefire: prepare_remote_object_set_digest (16801), prepare_http_upload_existing_publication_input (17570), prepare_http_upload_response_input (18287), prepare_http_upload_parser_scalar (18569), bind_http_upload_request_source (18694), prepare_http_upload_semantic (20400), prepare_http_upload_existing_project_gate (25704), prepare_http_upload_missing_project_bootstrap_transaction (26689), prepare_http_upload_existing_pair_semantic_carrier (28278), prepare_http_upload_existing_effect_input (28287), prepare_http_upload_sealed_ancestry (28768)
Measured owner-class spans total 11687 lines, approximately 35 percent of the 33456-line codefire script

22 of 30 tests/test_python_*.py files, at least 12547 of 17433 lines (about 72 percent), reference at least one unwired symbol; the true figure is higher because tests/test_python_existing_response_composition.py:3 imports another file's harness and tests/test_python_sealed_borrow.py targets a borrow API no production consumer receives

Decisive pairing: python3 -m unittest tests.test_python_ancestry_owner passes 13/13 in this worktree while the production ancestry path it nominally protects is the unbudgeted 300-read traversal of M1
must_findings.note: cfr-168.md and history.md consistently and honestly label these slices production-unwired and maintain a Freeze; the finding is that accumulated green counts must not be read as closure evidence at the Close gate
contract_violated: Review contract requirement that tests exercise production paths and cannot pass by testing only scaffolding
